## Source

*The Cincinnati Enquirer*, Cincinnati, Ohio · Wednesday, August 13, 1952, page 12

## Transcription

Miss Shelley Ann Lindner, daughter of Mrs. Mary A. Lindner and Dr. Joseph Lindner, has chosen Saturday, September 27, as the date for her marriage to Lt. (j.g.) John Merrill Henderson, USN, son of Mr. and Mrs. John D. Henderson of Herkimer, N.Y.

The ceremony will take place at 4:30 o'clock in Calvary Episcopal Church, Clifton. It will be followed by a wedding reception at the University Club.

Miss Lindner, who has been residing in New York for the last two years, will arrive in Cincinnati September 2 to join her mother, and to complete the plans for her wedding.
